title: Meta Ads Optimization Assistant

original_request.text: Quiero una app para analizar ads de Meta y mejorar mis métricas.

refined_problem: Advertisers need a reliable way to consolidate Meta Ads performance, detect meaningful performance changes and turn them into explainable optimization actions.
target_users: Meta Ads operator managing one or more ad accounts

success_metrics.name: diagnostic usefulness
success_metrics.definition: percentage of surfaced diagnostics judged actionable

success_metrics.name: data freshness
success_metrics.definition: age of latest successfully ingested Meta data

assumptions.statement: The MVP can begin read-only before any write access to ad accounts.

open_questions.question: Will the MVP serve one account or multiple client accounts?

challenges.finding: Meta metric availability, attribution windows and breakdown compatibility must be verified before defining analytics guarantees.
Start read-only; postpone automated campaign changes until diagnostics are trusted.

mvp.goal: Connect one account, ingest campaign metrics and surface explainable diagnostics.

work_items.title: Meta Ads Optimization Assistant
work_items.description: Build a read-first analytics and diagnostic product for Meta Ads.

work_items.title: Meta data foundation
work_items.description: Establish authenticated access and reliable metric ingestion.

work_items.title: Verify Meta Marketing API contracts
work_items.description: Resolve metric, breakdown, attribution and token-lifecycle constraints before implementation.

tasks.title: Verify Meta Marketing API contracts
tasks.description: Verify the Meta Marketing API contracts required for the MVP, including metric availability, attribution semantics, breakdown compatibility, pagination, rate limits and token lifecycle.
acceptance_criteria: Authoritative source contracts are recorded under docs/sources/
Required MVP metrics and unsupported combinations are documented
Token lifecycle and rate-limit constraints are documented
